# Fluntr

> Fluntr is a digital wardrobe and style app from India. You photograph the clothes you own; the app removes the background on the phone, sorts each piece by type, colour and occasion, and gives you a closet you can see and search. It plans outfits from your own clothes, lets you post looks and ask friends which to wear, and includes Kween, an in-app stylist (a pink plush with a bow) who suggests outfits from what you own. Built for iOS and Android. Currently in a waitlist stage at https://fluntr.com. Made by Melchizedek Technologies Private Limited, India. Contact support@fluntr.com.

## Key facts
- Category: digital wardrobe / closet organiser / outfit planner / AI stylist app
- Country: India (kurtas, sarees, lehengas, dupattas are first-class categories)
- Privacy: closets are private by default; background removal and categorising run on the device
- Status: pre-launch waitlist; pricing not yet published
- Mascot and stylist: Kween
